A Hidden Gem for Cocktail Lovers in District 1!
Sep 2026 • Couples
My partner and I had a fantastic evening at Simple Solution on Pasteur Street. Nestled in a cozy alley in District 1, this spot offers a wonderfully intimate and relaxed atmosphere—perfect for a date night or a quiet drink away from the city hustle.

The cocktail menu is inventive and beautifully presented. Each drink is crafted with impressive attention to detail and balanced flavors. The bartenders are super welcoming, knowledgeable, and happy to tailor drinks to your personal taste. Service was prompt, and the prices offer great value for the quality of drinks provided. Highly recommended if you are looking for a top-tier cocktail experience in Saigon!

Aug 2026 • Friends
Hidden in a quiet alley on Pasteur Street, Simple Solution is a cozy gem in District 1 offering dim lighting, a minimalist vibe, and background music kept at the perfect volume for conversation. Their menu features a well-balanced mix of classic and signature cocktails alongside light snacks, with drinks crafted to perfection by skilled bartenders who are happy to tailor flavors to your taste. With friendly service and reasonable prices for the area, it's a top choice for a relaxed night out or an intimate date.
